name: Hysterical Harry
source:
Hysterical Harry is the Ultimate Conspiracy Theorist, a rabbit who believes aliens are real and the government is hiding things. When the killing game starts he hides himself in his room, extremely paranoid. 

[spoiler]As toons start dying Harry becomes more sharp-tongued and rude, believing that everyone has the potential for murder.[/spoiler]
